captions.detailed: A dual-hopper pedestal candy vendor featuring two tall, clear cylindrical reservoirs mounted side-by-side on a shared red rectangular base. Each reservoir contains a colored candy mass (one pinkish-red, one green) and is topped by a grey lid, while the entire assembly is supported on a central grey pedestal stand with a circular base. Two black selector knobs are located on the front of the red base below the outlets, flanking a central grey pickup cup door. The selector knobs rotate continuously on horizontal axes, the two top lids open via rear hinges, and the pickup door pivots on a lower hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a freestanding dual-hopper candy vendor on a pedestal stand. The model should include a shared red base, a central vertical pedestal on a circular foot, two separate transparent cylindrical reservoirs with internal candy masses and top lids, two front selector knobs, and a central pickup flap. Configure continuous rotation for the knobs, and revolute joints for the top lids and the pickup door.
captions.factory: Construct the base assembly using a Box for the red main housing, a Cylinder for the pedestal shaft, and a larger flat Cylinder for the floor stand. Create the two reservoirs using transparent cylinders, filling them with smaller colored cylinders representing the candy, and cap them with flat cylinder lids. Model the front interface by adding a central pickup door (Box) and two separate selector knobs (Cylinders) positioned on either side. Define the kinematics using continuous joint articulations for both knobs, and revolute joints for the top lids and the front pickup door.
